text:
The median asking rent in Duisburg stands at 8.49 €/m², up 4.9 % year‑on‑year and 27.6 % over the last five years, placing the city 34th of the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 2.4 % and an average of 35 days on market; 19 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is moderate: a 60 m² unit costs about 509 € per month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 14.5 %. Asking rents sit 45 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 5.84 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 8.95 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 8.71 €/m² and 9.08 €/m², implying a 5.4 % increase.
